device.name: Oxford Instruments Mercury iTC temperature controller (PSI Bluesky4)

facts.text: The module fixes the Mercury iTC device address STILL_DB6.T1
connect opens a pyvisa resource and sets the newline write and read terminators
query connects, sends the command through pyvisa's query and disconnects
write connects, sends the command and disconnects
read_temperature sends READ:DEV:<address>:TEMP:SIG:TEMP and parses the last field, stripping a trailing K
set_p_value sends SET:DEV:<address>:TEMP:LOOP:P:<value> and reads back LOOP:P
set_i_value sends SET:DEV:<address>:TEMP:LOOP:I:<value> and reads back LOOP:I
set_d_value sends SET:DEV:<address>:TEMP:LOOP:D:<value> and reads back LOOP:D
set_heater_setpoint sends SET:DEV:<address>:TEMP:LOOP:HSET:<value> and reads back LOOP:HSET
set_flow_setpoint sends SET:DEV:<address>:TEMP:LOOP:FSET:<value> and reads back LOOP:FSET
set_gas_flow writes LOOP:TSET but its follow-up query is a literal string containing {device_address}, so this driver sends the SET line through write instead
get_gas_flow reads LOOP:TSET and removes the last character of the reply as a unit suffix
get_p_value, get_i_value, get_d_value and get_heater_setpoint read LOOP:P, LOOP:I, LOOP:D and LOOP:HSET
The only numeric default in the class is the 10000 ms VISA timeout, a transport timeout and not a device range
The upstream README describes the repository as the backend for controlling instruments at PSI

measures.description: Temperature measured by the Mercury iTC (TEMP:SIG:TEMP)

operator_required.name: temperature_setpoint
operator_required.reason: the clone writes TSET (Bluesky4/mercury_itc.py:57) but states no valid range; the site sets the temperature range its sample and cryostat allow

operator_required.name: heater_setpoint
operator_required.reason: the clone writes HSET (Bluesky4/mercury_itc.py:81) but states no valid range; the site sets the heater-loop range of its unit

operator_required.name: p_value
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states a valid range for this loop value; the upstream module only builds the SET/READ command and never checks a range, so the site supplies the range of its Mercury iTC
